definition: Unique identifier for each effect size.
Identifier for an exposed experimental cohort retained across its assays and outcomes.
Identifier for a control group within an experiment and study.
Outcome identifier and reported behavioural measure.
Behavioural test used to measure the outcome.
Offspring age and timing of behavioural measurement.
Mean, standard deviation, and sample size for the exposed group.
Mean, standard deviation, and sample size for the control group.
Log response ratio calculated in Chapter 2.
Sampling variance of the log response ratio calculated in Chapter 2.
Specifies an independent or correlated comparison within one effect size.
Indicates comparisons that use a shared control group.
Labels for reported comparisons; not used as cohort identifiers.
